fact: The Financial Consumer Protection (Disclosure of Credit Information) Regulations, 2023 (Legal Notice 24), gazetted 24 February 2023, require providers of digital credit to present a simplified Key Fact statement and to tell borrowers of their right to appeal to the consumer complaints unit of the Central Bank of Lesotho.
title: Financial Consumer Protection (Disclosure of Credit Information) Regulations, 2023 (Government Gazette Vol. 68 No. 11)
